summary: Retest of the iteration 4 fixes only. All pass. HIGH fix: two 375x667 browser contexts. B joined A's game with the code. A ended it with 'End this game for everyone'. B was back on Welcome about 3.5s later, and 'welcome-game-gone' stayed visible at +0.5s, +4.5s and +9.5s. B's localStorage game_code was cleared. A second check deleted the game through the API: the message appeared after about 4.3s and was still there 3s later. After B joined another game and then left it, the message was gone. Join input: 'ab-c d12345' becomes 'ABCD1' for both paste/fill and per-key typing, and there is no maxlength attribute. join-error disappears on edit (typing a character, re-filling, or typing an extra character when the code is already full). The copy says '5-character code' and '5-letter' no longer appears. Welcome: tapping welcome-join-button straight away, with no pre-wait, opened the join screen in under 1s. Backend: all 42 existing tests pass (-n 0). The new test_per_game_lock.py passes 2/2: 24 parallel turns across 2 games (mixed upper/lower-case codes) finished in 1.8s with none lost (12/12 each), and 6 games created in parallel got unique codes. Deprecated packages detected: none checked or changed in this retest scope.

minor.issue: GAME_LOCKS is never pruned. A lock is created for every code that reaches a @locked endpoint, including deleted games and made-up codes that return 404, so memory grows without limit over time. Low impact for a family app. Fix: pop the lock in DELETE /games/{code}, or only add one after the game is found.

action_items: OPTIONAL/LOW: Prune GAME_LOCKS when a game is deleted, and don't create locks for codes that don't exist (server.py:156).
critical_code_review_comments: game-code.tsx: the 'gone' flag is kept in memory only, so it is cleared by a new setCode(code) (join or create) and by an app restart. This is acceptable. It also stays visible if the user opens Setup and then backs out, which is also acceptable.
join.tsx: input is cleaned with replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g,'').toUpperCase().slice(0,5) and join.reset() runs on every change. Correct.
seed_data_creation: Created games MSUEY, 8RQU6 and T4EVH, plus the games made by test_per_game_lock.py. All deleted, and GET returns 404.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0. A deleted game's GET returns 404 {'detail':'No game found with that code'}. In Playwright, a Backspace press after clicking the submit button lands with the caret at position 0, so it is a no-op. Use fill() or type a character to test editing. Use .jpg paths when passing quality to screenshots. A second phone can be made with page.context.browser.new_context().
rca_of_issue: Fix verified: the gone flag now lives in GameCodeProvider state (setGone in setCode(null,{gone:true})), so it survives the game query reset that used to remount Welcome without data.gone.
